entities.name: Boragor
entities.description: A human necromancer hermit from Shandalar who worshiped Xathrid, a planeswalker hunter killed by Garruk.

entities.name: Vronos
entities.description: Sent planeswalker hunters to capture Garruk.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Planeswalker hunted by Vronos's group who killed Boragor with his axe.

entities.name: Kento
entities.description: Another hunter, already killed by Garruk.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The one to whom Garruk was to be brought to be cured.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane where the hunters found Garruk.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where Vronos summoned the hunters.

events.summary: Vronos summoned Boragor and other planeswalkers to Innistrad to capture Garruk and bring him to Avacyn.
events.quote: Boragor was summoned by Vronos in Innistrad

events.summary: Garruk found Boragor mid-ritual on Alara; despite his black magic and zombies, Boragor fell before Garruk's axe.
events.quote: but he ultimately fell before his axe

relations.quote: but he ultimately fell before his axe

relations.note: One of the hunters sent by Vronos.
relations.quote: Boragor was one of the Planeswalker hunters sent by Vronos to capture Garruk
